Junior DevOps Engineer

Remote (United States) · Full-time

Harborline Health is hiring a Junior DevOps Engineer to help keep our patient scheduling platform reliable. This is a fully remote position for candidates based in the United States.

What you'll do

  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and Jenkins
  • Manage containerized services with Docker and Kubernetes on Azure
  • Write runbooks and automate routine operational tasks with Python and Bash

What we're looking for

  • 1-3 years of experience in a DevOps, SRE, or systems administration role
  • Hands-on experience with Linux servers and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP)
  • Working knowledge of Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or equivalent practical experience

Bonus points

  • Azure or AWS certification
  • Experience in a HIPAA-regulated environment

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $78,000 - $92,000 USD per year, plus benefits.

Application deadline: November 30, 2026.
